sentences.en: It's not good economics.
sentences.zh: 但这在经济上并不合理。

sentences.en: But the politics you're talking about, it's not just politics.
sentences.zh: 但你所说的政治，不仅仅是政治。

sentences.en: So doesn't that challenge this idea of globalization as an inevitable force?
sentences.zh: 那么，这难道不挑战了全球化作为一种不可抗拒力量的观点吗？

sentences.en: It's not that we should buy into the other fantasy that mainstream economists and free traders in both major political parties have been selling us for many decades,
sentences.zh: 并不是说我们应该相信主流经济学家和两大政党的自由贸易派几十年来一直向我们兜售的另一种幻想，

sentences.en: which is that free trade is the answer to all of our probleMs.
sentences.zh: 即自由贸易是我们所有问题的答案。

sentences.en: And if you have a problem with it, you're just a whiner or a loser.
sentences.zh: 如果你对此有异议，你只是个爱抱怨的人或失败者。

sentences.en: That's also a fantasy.
sentences.zh: 那也是一种幻想。

sentences.en: I mean, what we've learned is that China, for instance, entering the World Trade Organization in 2001, had a much greater shock in large American communities.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们了解到，例如中国在2001年加入世界贸易组织，对美国的大型社区造成了更大的冲击。

sentences.en: And can you just quickly explain why that was such a significant moment?
sentences.zh: 你能简要解释一下为什么那是一个如此重要的时刻吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Because China is huge.
sentences.zh: 因为中国太庞大了。

sentences.en: And when China got into the WTO, it was ready.
sentences.zh: 当中国加入世贸组织时，它已经准备好了。

sentences.en: It was ready with entire regions that were concentrated on certain slices of industry, you know, whole towns that made plumbing supplies.
sentences.zh: 它准备好了，整个地区都集中在某些特定的工业领域，你知道，整个城镇都在生产管道配件。

sentences.en: I visited a town in Giugian province that suddenly was making 70% of the neckties on Earth, you know, and that walloped parts of northern Italy that were dependent upon revenues
sentences.zh: 我曾访问过浙江省的一个城镇，它突然生产了地球上70%的领带，你知道，这重创了意大利北部那些依赖

sentences.en: from high-quality neckties.
sentences.zh: 高质量领带收入的地区。

sentences.en: I mean, there was an adjustment process that the world went through, and we didn't prepare for that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，世界经历了一个调整过程，而我们并没有为此做好准备。

sentences.en: Our elite bought into this fantasy that, yeah, some jobs will be destroyed, but that will free up labor to go into new productive areas,
sentences.zh: 我们的精英阶层相信了这种幻想，即：是的，一些工作岗位会被摧毁，但这将释放劳动力进入新的生产领域，

sentences.en: and the creative powers that be will dream up new ideas.
sentences.zh: 而创造性的力量会构想出新的点子。

sentences.en: And maybe over time, that is, in fact, how our economy works.
sentences.zh: 也许随着时间的推移，事实确实如此，我们的经济就是这样运作的。

sentences.en: But, you know, as John Maynard Keynes famously said, in the long run, we're all dead.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，正如约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯那句名言所说，从长远来看，我们都死了。

sentences.en: And the reality is that if an entire community in Ohio or Pennsylvania or Illinois suddenly experiences 50% unemployment, the impacts of that go far beyond
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，如果俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州或伊利诺伊州的一个整个社区突然经历50%的失业率，其影响远远超出了

sentences.en: what an economic model might have captured.
sentences.zh: 经济模型所能捕捉到的范围。

sentences.en: I mean, suddenly, even if you are willing to do what the mainstream economists say that you should, and, you know, accept you've lost your job,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，突然之间，即使你愿意按照主流经济学家所说的那样去做，你知道，接受你失业的事实，

sentences.en: and now you're going to move your family to Arizona, where you can train to be a solar panel installer, well, 50% of your town is unemployed.
sentences.zh: 现在你要把家人搬到亚利桑那州，去接受太阳能电池板安装工的培训，好吧，你所在城镇50%的人都失业了。

sentences.en: Your house is not worth what it used to be.
sentences.zh: 你的房子不再值以前那么多钱了。

sentences.en: Maybe you can't sell it because you owe the bank more than your house is worth.
sentences.zh: 也许你卖不掉它，因为你欠银行的钱比房子的价值还多。

sentences.en: Maybe the people in your community have now got depression, and some of them are turning to drugs, and there's crime, and people don't want to buy your house,
sentences.zh: 也许你社区里的人现在患上了抑郁症，有些人开始吸毒，还有犯罪，人们不想买你的房子，

sentences.en: and you've got problems that go far beyond your career.
sentences.zh: 你面临的问题远远超出了你的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I mean, whole communities were leveled by this shock, and we failed to address this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，整个社区都被这场冲击夷为平地，而我们未能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: But the solution there is not to hurt economic growth and impede trade.
sentences.zh: 但解决办法不是损害经济增长和阻碍贸易。

sentences.en: The solution is to focus on preparing people for their next careers, to cushion the blow in terms of housing and education and healthcare.
sentences.zh: 解决办法是专注于让人们为下一份职业做好准备，在住房、教育和医疗方面减轻冲击。

sentences.en: It's just very simplistic to say if we stop trading with China, somehow these problems will just vanish.
sentences.zh: 说如果我们停止与中国贸易，这些问题就会凭空消失，这实在太简单化了。

sentences.en: So with President Trump meeting with the president of China at Mar-a-Lago today, is all this talk of a dangerous trade deficit really just a message for disenfranchised voters
sentences.zh: 那么，随着特朗普总统今天在海湖庄园会见中国国家主席，所有关于危险贸易逆差的言论真的只是给那些被剥夺了权利的选民传达的信息吗，

sentences.en: in the United States, or should we expect meaningful change between China and the United States now?
sentences.zh: 还是我们现在应该期待中美之间发生有意义的改变？

sentences.en: I'm going to weasel out of that question.
sentences.zh: 我打算回避这个问题。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Noting that, generally speaking, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 指出总的来说，美国

sentences.en: and China are in a kind of codependent relationship.
sentences.zh: 和中国处于一种相互依赖的关系中。

sentences.en: China depends upon access to the American market, which is the largest consumer market on earth, so that it can keep selling all of this stuff that it's making.
sentences.zh: 中国依赖于进入美国市场，这是地球上最大的消费市场，这样它才能继续销售它制造的所有这些东西。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而美国

sentences.en: is dependent upon China to continue to not only make our stuff, because so much of our own manufacturing and our own consumer economy is dependent upon this stream of goods
sentences.zh: 依赖中国继续不仅为我们制造产品，因为我们自己的制造业和消费经济很大程度上依赖于这股

sentences.en: coming in from China, but also that China then takes that money that it makes from this trade and buys our debt, which maintains borrowing costs
sentences.zh: 从中国涌入的商品流，而且中国还会用从贸易中赚来的钱购买我们的债务，这维持了美国的借贷成本

sentences.en: at a low level in the United States.
sentences.zh: 处于低水平。

sentences.en: But President Trump has introduced an extremely volatile wild card to this equation.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统在这个等式中引入了一个极其不稳定的变数。

sentences.en: And China is having a very difficult time figuring out who they're dealing with, what he really wants.
sentences.zh: 中国正非常艰难地弄清楚他们正在与谁打交道，他到底想要什么。

sentences.en: And again, he's taking trade advice from somebody who wrote a book called Death by China.
sentences.zh: 而且再说一次，他正在听取一个写过《致命中国》这本书的人的贸易建议。

sentences.en: So, this is damn near the hardest time to predict in this relationship that any of us can recall.
sentences.zh: 所以，这几乎是我们记忆中最难预测这种关系的时候了。

sentences.en: Thank you, Peter.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，彼得。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Here is what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: President Trump says his outrage over the chemical weapons attack in Syria has made him reassess his views of the country's president,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，他对叙利亚化学武器袭击事件的愤怒使他重新评估了对该国总统的看法，

sentences.en: Bashar al-Assad.
sentences.zh: 巴沙尔·阿萨德。

sentences.en: It's very, very possible.
sentences.zh: 这非常、非常有可能。

sentences.en: And I will tell you, it's already happened that my attitude toward Syria and Assad has changed very much.
sentences.zh: 而且我可以告诉你，我对叙利亚和阿萨德的态度已经发生了很大的改变。

sentences.en: In the past,
sentences.zh: 过去，

sentences.en: Trump has said he views Assad as a potential ally in the war on terror.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾表示他将阿萨德视为反恐战争中的潜在盟友。

sentences.en: Trump's ambassador to the United Nations,
sentences.zh: 特朗普的联合国大使，

sentences.en: Nikki Haley, said that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 妮基·黑利表示，美国

sentences.en: is prepared to act on its own to hold the Syrian government accountable for its conduct.
sentences.zh: 准备采取独立行动，追究叙利亚政府的行为责任。

sentences.en: When the United Nations consistently fails in its duty to act collectively, there are times in the life of states that we are compelled to take our own action.
sentences.zh: 当联合国在履行集体行动职责方面持续失败时，在国家生存的某些时刻，我们被迫采取自己的行动。

sentences.en: And President Trump has removed his chief strategist,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已经将他的首席战略顾问，

sentences.en: Steve Bannon, from the prestigious
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·班农，从享有盛誉的

sentences.en: National Security Council, reversing an unusual appointment that immediately provoked a backlash.
sentences.zh: 国家安全委员会中撤出，推翻了一项立即引发强烈抵制的不同寻常的任命。

sentences.en: Bannon, a former right-wing media mogul, has no experience in national security, and critics said his presence on the council risked politicizing its work.
sentences.zh: 班农曾是一位右翼媒体大亨，在国家安全方面毫无经验，批评人士称他在委员会中的存在有将其工作政治化的风险。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Although I am coming down with a cold, I hope to see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 虽然我有点感冒，但我希望明天能见到你。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
